package mp3

// ddsonic's contract with go-librespot's MP3 decoder, at the pinned version:
// a decoder is released by Close and by nothing else. See
// docs/ddsonic/design/spotify-token-coordinator.md, 4.3 and 14.5.

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"testing"

	librespot "github.com/devgianlu/go-librespot"
)

func decoder(t *testing.T) *Decoder {
	t.Helper()
	dir := os.Getenv("DDSONIC_CONTRACT_FIXTURES")
	if dir == "" {
		t.Fatal("DDSONIC_CONTRACT_FIXTURES is not set: run these tests through ddsonic's contract runner")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, "tone.mp3.bin"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	d, err := New(&librespot.NullLogger{}, bytes.NewReader(data), 1)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return d
}

// A reviewed expectation: a decoder whose references are dropped is still
// rooted, by the cgo handle it holds to itself. It is why a stream nobody
// accepted has its decoder closed. If a later go-librespot releases it some
// other way, this fails, and the expectation is updated in a reviewed change.
func TestDDSonicContractMP3HandleSurvivesDropAndGC(t *testing.T) {
	d := decoder(t)
	h := d.handle
	d = nil
	runtime.GC()
	runtime.GC()
	kept, ok := h.Value().(*Decoder)
	if !ok || kept == nil {
		t.Fatal("EXPECTATION CHANGED: the handle no longer roots the decoder")
	}
	kept.Close()
}

// STOP if this fails: closing a never-read decoder is how ddsonic releases
// it. Close deletes the handle and frees the native state, and may be called
// again.
func TestDDSonicContractMP3CloseReleasesHandle(t *testing.T) {
	d := decoder(t)
	h := d.handle
	if err := d.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Close() = %v", err)
	}
	if d.mh != nil || d.handlePtr != nil || d.handle != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after Close: decoder %v, handle pointer %v, handle %v; want all released", d.mh, d.handlePtr, d.handle)
	}
	func() {
		defer func() {
			if recover() == nil {
				t.Error("the handle still resolves after Close")
			}
		}()
		h.Value()
	}()
	if err := d.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Errorf("a second Close() = %v", err)
	}
}
